name: And You Are Left
source:
You wake up in a void, you feel as if you're almost floating... A man is with you, he is a God, and you're the only human left alive with him.

[From [url=https://offbranded.itch.io/and-you-are-left]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在虚空中醒来，感觉自己几乎漂浮在空中……有一个人与你同在，他是神，而你是唯一与他一起活着的人。

[来自[url=https://offbranded.itch.io/and-you-are-left]itch.io[/url]]
